specialties.name: ENT & Otolaryngology
specialties.summary: A clearer path for ear, nose, throat and voice care.
specialties.description: Recurring ear, voice, sinus and sleep concerns rarely arrive in a neat timeline.
specialties.alt: Illustrative ENT specialist examining an adult patient's ear in a bright modern clinic.

specialties.name: Cardiology
specialties.summary: Put heart health expertise within easier reach.
specialties.description: When the stakes feel high, patients need clear boundaries between education, preparation and decisions that belong with the cardiologist.
specialties.alt: Illustrative cardiologist explaining a heart model during a consultation.

specialties.name: Dermatology
specialties.summary: Bring clarity to skin health and treatment conversations.
specialties.description: Visual content can look persuasive long before the evidence is clear. Explain options carefully without outcome promises.
specialties.alt: Illustrative dermatologist examining a patient's forearm with a dermatoscope.

specialties.name: Pediatrics
specialties.summary: Help families find a reassuring, informed next step.
specialties.description: The person speaking may be a parent while the patient is a child. Preserve who reported what and what needs pediatric review.
specialties.alt: Illustrative pediatrician reassuring a parent and child during a routine examination.

specialties.name: Orthopedics
specialties.summary: Connect mobility, recovery and specialist expertise.
specialties.description: Pain, function, imaging and prior treatment often arrive from different places. Preparation should organize the story, not interpret it.
specialties.alt: Illustrative orthopedic specialist discussing a knee model with an adult patient.

specialties.name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
specialties.summary: Respectful information through every stage of life.
specialties.description: Sensitive questions need privacy aware communication, respectful context gathering and a clear route to professional care.
specialties.alt: Illustrative obstetrician discussing an ultrasound with an expectant mother.

specialties.name: Gastroenterology
specialties.summary: Make complex digestive health questions easier to navigate.
specialties.description: Symptoms can be vague and timelines complex. Help the person clarify what changed and what they want to understand.
specialties.alt: Illustrative gastroenterologist using a digestive system teaching model during a consultation.

specialties.name: Neurology
specialties.summary: Give complex stories the context and attention they need.
specialties.description: Long histories and uncertain chronology make source, time and attribution especially important.
specialties.alt: Illustrative neurologist discussing brain imaging in a modern consultation room.

specialties.name: Ophthalmology
specialties.summary: A clearer view of eye health and specialist care.
specialties.description: Help patients distinguish general eye health education from what requires an examination and an ophthalmologist's judgment.
specialties.alt: Illustrative ophthalmologist examining an adult patient's eye with a slit lamp.

specialties.name: General Medicine
specialties.summary: An accessible first connection to a medical practice.
specialties.description: Broad concerns need a clear starting point without forcing every patient into a generic symptom checklist.
specialties.alt: Illustrative general physician checking an adult patient's blood pressure.

specialties.name: Urology
specialties.summary: A thoughtful, private route to specialist expertise.
specialties.description: Private concerns benefit from a clear, respectful route to the right practice and minimal unnecessary collection.
specialties.alt: Illustrative urologist with a urinary system teaching model in a bright clinic.

specialties.name: Pulmonology
specialties.summary: Clearer communication around breathing and lung health.
specialties.description: Breathing, cough and sleep related concerns need clear boundaries between general information and doctor evaluation.
specialties.alt: Illustrative pulmonologist explaining a lung teaching model during a respiratory consultation.

specialties.name: Endocrinology & Diabetes
specialties.summary: Support conversations that evolve over time.
specialties.description: Longitudinal context changes over time. Old information should be reconfirmed instead of silently treated as current.
specialties.alt: Illustrative endocrinologist discussing a glucose monitoring device with an adult patient.

specialties.name: Dentistry
specialties.summary: Make dental services and the patient journey easier to understand.
specialties.description: Explain services clearly without turning promotional communication into claims of guaranteed clinical outcomes.
specialties.alt: A dentist explaining a dental model to an adult patient in a bright clinic

specialties.name: Psychiatry
specialties.summary: Thoughtful communication with privacy at its centre.
specialties.description: Privacy, sensitive language and realistic response expectations matter as much as technical fluency.
specialties.alt: A psychiatrist listening attentively to an adult during a consultation

specialties.name: Nephrology
specialties.summary: Keep kidney health conversations clear and connected.
specialties.description: Useful preparation depends on current, attributed information and a clear account of what changed.
specialties.alt: A nephrologist explaining kidney health using a teaching model

specialties.name: Rheumatology
specialties.summary: Bring changing symptoms and long histories into focus.
specialties.description: Long histories and uncertainty make structured chronology and patient goals especially useful.
specialties.alt: A rheumatologist gently examining an adult patient's hands

specialties.name: Oncology
specialties.summary: Careful information for consequential conversations.
specialties.description: High consequence information requires especially careful evidence, uncertainty and professional review.
specialties.alt: An oncologist having a reassuring conversation with an adult patient

specialties.name: General Surgery
specialties.summary: Help patients understand the practice and prepare their questions.
specialties.description: Set accurate expectations about practice scope, preparation and the next appropriate step.
specialties.alt: A surgeon in a bright modern operating theatre with surgical equipment

specialties.name: Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
specialties.summary: Clear scope, realistic expectations and informed conversations.
specialties.description: Education should avoid outcome promises and preserve realistic, informed expectations.
specialties.alt: A plastic and reconstructive surgeon discussing care with an adult patient

specialties.name: Pain Medicine
specialties.summary: Give the person’s goals and experience room to be heard.
specialties.description: A patient's goals and prior journey can matter as much as a symptom label.
specialties.alt: A pain specialist discussing a spine model with an adult patient

specialties.name: Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
specialties.summary: Connect everyday function, recovery and changing goals.
specialties.description: Progress and changing goals are inherently longitudinal and should remain attributable over time.
specialties.alt: A physiotherapist guiding an adult through a resistance band exercise

specialties.name: Ayurveda
specialties.summary: A professional presence with clear services and scope.
specialties.description: Help people understand the practitioner’s qualifications, actual services and practice approach. Keep patient education clear about evidence, scope and the need for individual assessment.
specialties.alt: An Ayurveda practitioner consulting with an adult in a bright botanical setting

specialties.name: Radiology
specialties.summary: Make diagnostic services and appointment preparation easier to find.
specialties.description: Patients and referring clinicians need accurate service information, practical appointment instructions and a clear route to the imaging practice. Patient specific interpretation belongs with the appropriate clinician.
specialties.alt: A radiologist in a bright diagnostic imaging room beside a scanner

specialties.name: Critical Care & ICU
specialties.summary: Clear practice information for complex care settings.
specialties.description: Families and clinical teams need clear professional information and appropriate contact pathways. A practice website supports communication; urgent clinical care belongs with the treating team.
specialties.alt: Critical care clinicians reviewing monitoring equipment in a bright ICU
